test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

This region was struck by unusual wave of violence last year.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1) i.e., **was struck by unusual.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**unusual wave of violence"** should be preceded by a determiner.
 
• The article "**an**" is required before the adjective "unusual" to indicate one specific instance.
 
• Omitting the article "an" makes the noun phrase incomplete and grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct wording should be "**was struck by an unusual wave of violence."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: was struck by an unusual.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2) i.e., wave of violence: **This part of the sentence is correct. "Wave of violence" is a proper noun phrase indicating a series of violent events.
 
• **Option 3) i.e., This region: **This part is correct. "This region" appropriately introduces the subject of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4) i.e., last year: **This part is also correct. "Last year" correctly indicates the time frame in which the events took place.
